$comment: The genre-trend scouting line (DECISIONS.md 'Genre-trend scouting'). Started by the 'Weekly genre scout' routine (seeded disabled) or by hand. scout-retention (engine) first deletes scouting notes more than 90 days old (logged; the blocklist stays). TREND-SCOUT writes internal notes (scouting/<day>/notes.json) and 4 genre briefs in this line's own drafts folder (scout-drafts/<day>/, so the research line can run the same day); scout-notes (engine) checks the notes, adds every recorded name to the scouting blocklist and blocks any genre brief naming a scouted game; EVIDENCE-CHECKER then checks the rest as usual; brief-check copies a verified brief to briefs/ or rejected/. The notes never leave the research folder. E6 b1 `outputs`: the output contract the runtime checks when the agent ends its turn (2 nudges at most, then the job ends incomplete; a partial set of drafts continues with the shortfall recorded).
label: Genre scout
